messages.subject: R1043 schedule comparison complete
messages.body: Compared source-backed C16/C64, 64-work-item, and overlapped staging alternatives against the current BF16 QSA schedule, including static SLM totals, subgroup participation, barrier convergence, numerical-order changes, and counterevidence. The report confirms the current 128-work-item schedule's asymmetrical QK/PV subgroup use and concludes that smaller chunks trade SLM for more barriers while larger chunks risk residency; no path is qualified without current device evidence. Remaining work is Main-owned selector/resource capture and isolated numerical/performance gates; report: bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round1043-v1.txt
